name: Winter Days
source:
Two lovers go on a getaway at a snowy cabin. With sizzling romance, things get steamy between the two of them. Yet, when all is said and done, will their connection burn with the same passionate intensity? In this drama, love can grow hot or cold in a matter of words.

[From [url=https://activedaydreamer.itch.io/winter-days]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个恋人在雪地小屋里度假。伴随着炽热的浪漫，两人之间的气氛变得热烈起来。然而，当一切尘埃落定之后，他们的联系还会以同样的热情燃烧吗？在这部剧中，爱情可以在一言一行之间变得炽热或冷淡。

[来自[url=https://activedaydreamer.itch.io/winter-days]itch.io[/url]]
